info.name: OpenSky Network REST Flights State Vectors API

params.name: time
params.description: The time in seconds since epoch (Unix timestamp) to retrieve state vectors for. Current time is used if omitted.

params.name: icao24
params.description: One or more ICAO24 transponder addresses represented by a hex string (e.g. abc9f3). To filter multiple aircraft, repeat this parameter.

params.name: lamin
params.description: Lower bound for the latitude in decimal degrees of the bounding box.

params.name: lomin
params.description: Lower bound for the longitude in decimal degrees of the bounding box.

params.name: lamax
params.description: Upper bound for the latitude in decimal degrees of the bounding box.

params.name: lomax
params.description: Upper bound for the longitude in decimal degrees of the bounding box.

params.name: extended
params.description: Set to 1 to request the extended state vector format which includes aircraft category (index 17).

items.docs: Retrieve any state vector of the OpenSky Network. Returns state vectors for all aircraft currently tracked. Rate limits apply (see rate limiting documentation). Anonymous users receive 10-second resolution; authenticated users receive 5-second resolution.

params.name: time
params.description: The time in seconds since epoch (Unix timestamp) to retrieve state vectors for. Current time is used if omitted.

params.name: icao24
params.description: One or more ICAO24 transponder addresses represented by a hex string. To filter multiple aircraft, repeat this parameter.

params.name: serials
params.description: Receiver serial numbers to filter results. To filter for multiple receivers, repeat this parameter.

items.docs: Retrieve state vectors for your own sensors. This endpoint requires authentication and is not rate limited for your own receivers. Returns state vectors from sensors you operate.
